latest_release.name: Duplicacy Command Line Version 3.3.0
latest_release.body:
* Verify the chunk id of every chunk before upload: https://github.com/gilbertchen/duplicacy/commit/54f97522bff9df8be6797873203310ccbf5a5b00
* Added an option to store metadata chunks separately from file chunks: https://github.com/gilbertchen/duplicacy/commit/0c0392d1655e5e7807fb76169980e55c66cbaece
* B2: switched to API v4 to support multi-bucket keys: https://github.com/gilbertchen/duplicacy/commit/4645cc0c3fa888a227296e287713157791d17b5f
* Upgraded dependencies with known vulnerabilities: https://github.com/gilbertchen/duplicacy/commit/5debf42021e2566193369f9915f6c7824424876f
* Upgraded Go to version 1.26.9 (requires macOS 12 or later)
